in_arabic.name: مظفر
in_arabic.long_meaning: مظفر (Muthaffar) means strong, brave and victorious in Arabic. The name Muzaffar is derived from the Arabic root word 'Thafara' which means to be strong, to protect and to defend. The name is popular among Muslims due to its association with courage and strength.

in_urdu.name: مظفر
in_urdu.long_meaning: The Urdu translation of the name Muzhaffar is 'مظلوم سے محفوض' (Muzloom se Mahfooz), which means 'Protected from the Oppressed'. This name is believed to bestow strength and courage upon the child, and to shield them from harm.

in_hindi.name: मुठफ़फर
in_hindi.long_meaning: The Hindi translation of the name Muzhaffar is 'मुठफ़फर' (Mutthafar), which means 'strong, brave and bow-wielding'. The name is popular among Hindus as well as Muslims, and is believed to bestow strength, courage and protection upon the child.

in_pashto.name: مظفر
in_pashto.long_meaning: The Pashto translation of the name Muzhaffar is 'لوغوی، بلوار' (Logoi, Bolwar), which means 'strong, brave and warrior'. This name is popular among Pashtuns, and is believed to bestow strength, courage and martial prowess upon the child.
